reason: Current evidence is insufficient to determine which breed originated first. A bridge note can connect the Basset Bleu de Gascogne's descent from the Grand Bleu de Gascogne to its origin date, and a verification note can check the Russell Terrier's origin relative to the Parson Russell Terrier.

derived_candidates.text: The Basset Bleu de Gascogne is descended from the Grand Bleu de Gascogne, which originated in the Middle Ages.
The Russell Terrier is a conformation show variety of the Jack Russell Terrier, which was first recognized in the 19th century.
